scope: Owner-performed Mac scenarios. Collector is passive. No native result exists yet.

cases.action: Drag the mpv window by its native titlebar, then by the GOR drag area; release, including outside the window.
cases.pass: Overlay stays aligned, no snap-back; mouse-up releases drag ownership.
cases.evidence: Screen recording or owner observation plus logs. Static source tests cannot prove latency.

cases.action: Enter fullscreen, use the GOR minimize button; restore. Repeat once. During a second pending minimize, toggle fullscreen deliberately.
cases.pass: Fullscreen exits before minimization; restore works; explicit fullscreen cancels pending minimize. No forced timeout miniaturize.

cases.action: Open a fresh video, wait until it is playing, press Space once and wait 3 seconds. Press Space again to resume.
cases.pass: First press holds pause, brightness fade does not undo pause. Resume advances position. Repeat once immediately after a fresh load.

cases.action: With adaptive brightness enabled and ALS unavailable, compare idle panel, loaded video, paused video, audio-only file, embedded-cover MP3/FLAC and standalone image, stopped video and transition gap.
cases.pass: Camera fallback only with loaded video; pause sampling remains intentional; audio-only/cover/image/idle/stop/gap stay off. VR head tracking remains off while paused.

cases.action: Restart once using the menu, then once using Shift+Q. After each restart wait until the new window is ready.
cases.pass: New GOR survives; old GOR/mpv retire; startup takeover is logged if old instance is still exiting.

cases.action: While GOR is running normally, open the same app again without choosing restart.
cases.pass: Existing app activates; no second persistent GOR/mpv instance.

cases.action: Quit during playback and once while paused; do not interrupt the fade. Record any error or leftover process.
cases.pass: Brightness restores once; quit completes; SCE tap teardown is logged; final process snapshot has no owned orphan mpv.

excluded: Any automatic UI or playback mutation

shortcut_stress_design.steps: Use a bounded short mix of existing size/strength/sharp increase/decrease and toggle shortcuts. Record exact key order/times and the first visible failure; stop on a freeze or crash.
shortcut_stress_design.required_evidence: Source/build hashes, exact input trace, before/after state, last successful frame, crash report if present. No root cause inferred from a rapid-key report alone.
